contract.service: Explicit TableControls, PendantDisplay, plain TextDictionaries and injected KeyboardInput; no native UI
contract.binding: Captured ordinary typed static global array cells, attached-program and explicit system paths, and supplied BOOLEAN/INTEGER ports; output/resource overlap rejected
contract.editing: Typed finite/range checked commits; bounded insertion/cursors, numeric and function-key enums, submenu choices, BOOL keys/toggles, inactive columns and prefix change grids
contract.lifetime: Root and record-owned sessions, explicit cancellation and NEW_MENU release; internal loop finally cleanup and active-session save guard
contract.lists: Resident absolute item numbers, validated selected viewport and zero-based field columns; atomic preflight for paint plus FILE cursor
contract.limits: 64 sessions, 40 columns, 16384 cells, 32766 rows, 254 input characters and 4096 loop events
contract.persistence: Inactive manager window/limit/finite sequence only; pendant and keyboard preserve ordinary closed state

boundaries: Portable constants/statuses, COL_DESC_T schema, opaque XWORK_T ID and logical vptr ordinals; no native ABI or controller validation
Logical headers, help and enum selection; no native soft-key paging layout, DISCTRL_FORM or glyph/highlight rendering
No background display task or resident list fetching; logical repaint at keys and budgeted waits

enumeration_extension.contract: Field-local F1 through F10 and Boolean F4/F5 keys. Portable F4 submenu with up to 35 entries, guarded row/column identity and the existing validated commits. Numeric entry remains supported.
